contract.provides: Conditional source-reported generic exact acquisition of a fixed scalar response map under calibrated independent additive rank-one controls, fixed source/detector and stable repeated reference. Query count Q(m)=(3m^2-m+4)/2 for m>=2 (three for m=1), with weighted-transpose gauge preserving all allowed predictions. Fixed-anchor schedule has no uniform robustness; weak-anchor separation can be arbitrarily faint. For every even m>=4, a strictly dissipative pair agrees under every intervention changing fewer than all m controls and differs on a collective response; the m=32 rank reversal is scoped, not universal for every m. One full-support query separates that pair. No exponential query lower bound, physical validation or matched advantage is established.
